alert.title: Admin Proximity Alert
alert.body: Two sets of shoes in the hallway. One is the assistant principal. The other is someone in a lanyard you do not recognize, which means district.

actions.label: Fix the objective board
actions.blurb: 3 seconds. You will have to stop talking.

actions.label: Get Kayla up
actions.blurb: 3 seconds. She will say it loudly.

actions.label: Insert a turn-and-talk
actions.blurb: 2 seconds to launch. Satisfies a look-for. Kills the momentum of the best discussion you've had in a month.

actions.label: Do nothing. Teach the lesson.
actions.blurb: Uses your whole turn. The lesson you were already teaching keeps going.

bridge.title: They step back into the hall.

prompts.line: "I noticed only about four students spoke during the discussion. Talk to me about your engagement strategy."

choices.label: "You're right — I want to build in more structured turn-and-talks."
choices.blurb: Fidelity +. You now owe a follow-up.

choices.label: "Those four were the ones who'd read it."
"That's a great point, I'll add it to my growth plan."

structure.line: "Good. I'll check back in on that next time I'm in."

closing.title: Observation complete
closing.body: You'll see the write-up in your email. Eventually.
